definitions.gloss: horse racing ticket; betting slip; racing bet
definitions.explanation: A ticket purchased to bet on horse races, representing a wager on which horse or combination of horses will win, place, or show. Horse racing is one of the few forms of legal gambling in Japan.

examples.english: To buy a horse racing ticket.

examples.japanese: {馬券|ばけん}が{当|あ}たって{大喜|おおよろこ}びした。
examples.english: I was overjoyed when my racing bet won.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{毎週|まいしゅう}{日曜日|にちようび}に{競馬場|けいばじょう}に{行|い}って{馬券|ばけん}を{買|か}うのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: My father's weekly pleasure is going to the racetrack on Sundays to buy betting tickets.

notes:
Composed of {馬|ば} (horse) + {券|けん} (ticket/voucher). Formally called {勝馬投票券|かちうまとうひょうけん} (winning horse voting ticket). Horse racing ({競馬|けいば}) is one of the major forms of legalized gambling in Japan, along with bicycle racing, boat racing, and motorcycle racing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {馬券|ばけん}を{買|か}う: to buy a racing ticket
- {馬券|ばけん}が{当|あ}たる: to win on a racing bet
- {馬券|ばけん}を{外|はず}す: to lose a racing bet
- {馬券|ばけん}{売|う}り{場|ば}: ticket-selling area at a racetrack

TYPES OF BETS:
- {単勝|たんしょう}: win (picking the first-place horse)
- {複勝|ふくしょう}: place (picking a top-three horse)
- {馬連|うまれん}: quinella (picking first and second in any order)
- {三連単|さんれんたん}: trifecta (first, second, third in exact order)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Horse racing is regulated by the JRA ({日本|にほん}{中央|ちゅうおう}{競馬会|けいばかい}) and local governments. {馬券|ばけん} can be purchased at racetracks, off-track betting facilities, and online.
